values.index.html_28: CONCEPT ILLUSTRATION · NOT A PRODUCT SCREENSHOT
values.index.html_32: A student-only learning platform I’m building around one continuous loop: study, practise, measure mastery, revisit weak areas—and adapt.
values.index.html_38: Quizzes, private study materials, semantic retrieval, mastery and retention tracking, and spaced-repetition flashcards.
values.index.html_40: Practice and exam modes use server-authoritative timing and scoring, with results, history and leaderboards. An adaptive student model tracks topic-level mastery, accuracy, confidence, performance trends and retention to guide practice.
values.index.html_41: Uploaded PDF, TXT and Markdown materials are extracted, structured and chunked. BGE-small-en-v1.5 produces 384-dimensional embeddings for Qdrant retrieval with student-level isolation. Flashcards use SM-2 spaced repetition.
values.index.html_42: React, TypeScript and Tailwind power the interface; Node.js, Express and PostgreSQL support the backend. Argon2id authentication, server-managed sessions and academic-profile-based curriculum eligibility provide the foundation.
values.index.html_44: The AI Gateway and provider abstraction are in place. A working production LLM provider is not yet integrated; Gemini is the first candidate to test.
values.index.html_45: The next phase connects contextual teaching, document-grounded quizzes and flashcards, and study-material generation to permission-checked backend tools. Generated content must pass deterministic validation before creating anything inside AVEN. Scoring, mastery, retention and database changes remain controlled by the application.
values.index.html_48: Currently hosted at the original EduMate address.
values.index.html_57: INTERACTIVE EXPLANATION · NOT A LIVE AI RUN
values.index.html_61: SmartStudy combines sequential, parallel and loop agents to turn a student’s requirements into a reviewed study plan.
values.index.html_66: A coordinator and planning agent prepare the brief. Three specialists analyze topics, practice and scheduling in parallel. A writer combines their outputs, followed by a review-and-revision loop of up to two iterations. Built for the “Beyond Chatbots” workshop assignment.

backend.title:
The work behind
the screen.
